subdomain.name: Compliance & Risk
subdomain.capability: Screen transactions and account operations against sanctions, PEP lists and velocity patterns.
subdomain.why_distinct: Regulatory language, watchlist data and operator override audit rules differ from banking operations.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Check against Politically Exposed Persons lists.
Frequency/volume pattern used to detect anomalies.
Hold on a transaction triggered by a compliance match, distinct from account Hold.

bounded_contexts.name: Transaction Screening
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Screen transactions and decide clearance, flagging or suspension, with audited overrides.
invariants: Transactions over 5000 USD or cross-border undergo real-time sanction screening before payment authorization completes
A compliance match issues a Compliance Hold, notifies the Risk Operations Queue and publishes TransactionSuspended
Overrides are logged with operator ID, regulatory justification and cryptographic audit timestamp

assumptions.item: TransactionSuspended is named in rules but not in the event summary; assumed to coexist with ComplianceFlaggedEvent.
Overlap of thresholds: 5000 USD screening vs 10000 USD cross-border AML clearance in Payments.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Compliance owns screening decision; Payments only enforces that clearance exists.
